_comment: Modifiers for uniques and champions (core/monster_ai.py). 'stats' are added on top of the monster: <element>DamagePct adds that share of each hit as the element (the player's resistance takes its share), lifeLeech heals it by that share of what it deals. onHit 'slow': the player moves and swings slowerPct slower for slowSeconds. onDeath 'burst': it explodes (burstRadiusTiles, burstDamagePct of its average hit, burstElement; a cold burst slows too). onHurt 'charged_bolt': with chargedChance, each hit taken sends chargedBolts lightning sparks in every direction. ability 'teleport': if the player is farther than teleportMinTiles it appears beside them every teleportCooldown seconds. aura: like a leader's (radiusTiles + stats) for the monsters around it.
